categories.label: Sports Day
categories.title: Annual Sports Day
paragraphs: Our Annual Sports Day was a grand celebration of energy, teamwork and sportsmanship. Students participated with great enthusiasm in various track and field events showcasing their talent and determination.
categories.image_alt: Students competing in a sprint on the running track at Sports Day

categories.label: Cultural Events
categories.title: 19th Annual Day Celebrations
paragraphs: Students, parents, faculty and management came together to celebrate academic excellence, achievement and student talent at CPE’s 19th Annual Day.
Dance, music, singing and skits brought the college community together on stage.
categories.image_alt: CPE faculty together on the Annual Day stage

categories.label: Co-Curricular
categories.title: Talent beyond the classroom
paragraphs: Music, performance and student-led activities give students opportunities to express themselves beyond their academic studies.
From playing tabla to anchoring on stage, CPE students take an active part in college life.
categories.image_alt: A CPE student performing on tabla during Annual Day

categories.label: Other School Events
categories.title: Moments that bring us together
paragraphs: College life at CPE brings students and faculty together to celebrate progress, recognise effort and share memorable moments.
